quote: I admit it, Linda. This got away from me. But we can't turn back time. We have to hold our ground.
chinese: 我承认，琳达。这事超出我的掌控了。但时间无法倒流。我们必须坚守阵地。
reason: 承认失控后重申立场，转折清楚。

quote: I understand the logic, Frank, but we're in damage control now. We can't close one wound by opening another.
chinese: 我理解这个道理，弗兰克，但我们现在要控制损失。我们不能拆东墙补西墙。
reason: 让步后提出损失控制，含清晰隐喻。

quote: But you can't have it both ways, Linda. You can't have the reform you want and keep the teachers happy at the same time.
chinese: 但你不可能两头都占，琳达。你不能既得到想要的改革，同时又让教师满意。
reason: 用固定表达明确现实取舍。

quote: If I can break this strike and get everything we want in this bill, can we agree that's preferable to folding?
chinese: 如果我能结束这场罢工，并让法案保留我们想要的一切，我们能否同意这比认输更好？
reason: 条件句、比较和谈判收束完整。

quote: This is the worst possible position to be in. If I water down the bill, the president will still see me as a failure. If the strike doesn't end in a week, I forced myself into a corner. Only total victory will put me back in his good graces. The alternative is exile, which would mean the last five months were for nothing. I cannot abide falling back to square one.
chinese: 这是最糟的处境。如果我修改法案，总统还是会认为我失败了。如果罢工一周内不结束，我就把自己逼到了墙角。只有彻底胜利才能让我重获他的青睐。否则就是流放，那意味着过去五个月都白费了。我绝不能跌回原地。
reason: 完整的风险—后果—底线独白，适合识别 Frank 的论证节奏。

quote: No. Come on. Stretch your legs. I won't take no for an answer.
chinese: 进来吧，放松一下。别想拒绝我。
reason: 自然的邀请与坚持，含可迁移边界表达。

quote: You'll have six of my best men covering you around the clock. I guess I'm wondering why we didn't at least have one of your best men covering us now. He'll be disciplined, sir. He shot a gun in a residential neighborhood. I want him fired. There will be a full investigation, and we'll take the necessary action.
chinese: 我会派六名最好的手下全天候保护您。我只是想知道，为什么现在保护我们的至少不是您最好的手下之一。他会受处分，先生。他在居民区开了枪。我要他被解雇。我们会进行全面调查，并采取必要措施。
reason: 从安保安排到问责和调查，完整的危机回应。

quote: Two reasons, which are really the same reason. I was sick of working for other people, and I knew I could do a better job than my bosses. They kept trying to suppress me, shutting me out. So I said, "Fuck it. I'll do it my way."
chinese: 两个原因，其实是同一个原因。我受够了替别人工作，而且我知道自己能比老板做得更好。他们总想压制我、排斥我。所以我想：去他的，我按自己的方式来。
reason: 用 two reasons 和 own way 讲清职业转向，含粗口。

quote: I slaved away until I lined up the money to start Slugline.
chinese: 我一直苦干，直到筹够了创办头条网的钱。
reason: slaved away 和 line up the money 都是可迁移口语块。

quote: Come on. Slugline is just a stepping stone for you.
chinese: 得了吧，头条网只是你的垫脚石。
reason: 简短、自然的职业路径隐喻。

quote: When do I see you next? I'm background on this. I'm not your source. You can't talk now? No. When? Soon, with bells on.
chinese: 我什么时候能再见到你？这件事里我只是幕后人物，不是你的消息源。你现在不方便说话？不。那什么时候方便？很快，我随时乐意。
reason: 用 background、source 和 with bells on 划定关系与回应。

quote: Nah, it's too broad. We need a better sound bite. Something specific, something that points the finger directly at Spinella.
chinese: 不，太宽泛了。我们需要更好的简短口号。要具体，要能直接把矛头指向斯比奈拉。
reason: 从宽泛到具体，展示 sound bite 和 point the finger。

quote: No. We need something clear, something clean, something that sticks in your head.
chinese: 不行。我们需要清楚、简洁、让人过目不忘的说法。
reason: 排比压缩信息标准，语言价值高。

quote: It's disorganized labor, plain and simple. When you've got angry teachers throwing bricks through congressmen's windows, you've gotta blame the union leadership.
chinese: 这显然就是无组织劳工。当愤怒的教师向议员家的窗户扔砖头时，就必须把责任归咎于工会领导层。
reason: plain and simple 与 blame the leadership 组成清晰归因。

quote: Whether Mr. Spinella is behind this or not, he might wanna tone down the rhetoric before disorganized labor turns into organized crime.
chinese: 不管斯比奈拉先生是不是主使，他都该收敛言辞，免得无组织劳工变成有组织犯罪。
reason: 让步结构与 tone down the rhetoric 的完整句。

quote: When I told the unions to strike, I told them to prepare for the long haul, all right? Their accounts dry up, we keep going. We figure it out. I am not going to blink over something like this.
chinese: 我鼓动工会罢工时，就告诉他们要做好打持久战的准备，对吧？即使他们的钱耗尽，我们也会继续。我们会想出办法。我不会因为这种事就眨眼退缩。
reason: 持久战、资源耗尽与不退缩形成连续策略说明。

quote: I think this story is going to blow over. If I'm wrong, we'll reevaluate. But I wanna give it another day or two first. Okay?
chinese: 我认为这件事会平息。如果我错了，我们再重新评估。但我想先再给它一两天。好吗？
reason: 先判断，再给出 reevaluate 的备用方案。

quote: Here's how I see it. You asked me to come down. I did. We both had ideas about what that could mean. Probably very similar ideas. But then you changed your mind. So be it.
chinese: 我是这么看的。你要我过来，我就来了。我们都对这意味着什么有自己的想法，或许还很相像。但后来你改变了主意。那就这样吧。
reason: 完整陈述个人边界，保留 So be it 的收束。

quote: I just called because I care about you. No agenda. If you wanna talk again, call me.
chinese: 我只是因为在乎你才打电话。没有别的目的。你要是想再聊，就给我打电话。
reason: 温和表达关心、说明无目的并留下选择。

quote: I wanna be governor, and I want your help.
chinese: 我想当州长，也需要你的帮助。
reason: 直接提出目标与请求，适合角色化短句。

quote: Let me tell you something, Frank. I got elected to congress 'cause I seized the moment that opportunity struck. You kept me on that list. I wanna seize that opportunity. If you help me out, I'll give you everything I got.
chinese: 听我说，弗兰克。我能当选国会议员，是因为机会来临时我抓住了它。你把我留在了名单上。我想抓住这次机会。如果你帮我，我会倾尽全力。
reason: 以过去成功证明当前请求，结尾给出承诺。

quote: I feel like I've met the real you for the first time just now.
chinese: 我觉得直到现在，我才第一次见到真实的你。
reason: 简短但完整的人物判断，保留为 Archive。

quote: If you need anything at all, call me. You have my cell. Anything at all. And I'm sorry to have surprised you.
chinese: 有什么需要就联系我。你有我的手机号码。有什么事都可以。抱歉这次贸然而来。
reason: 完整的支持与道歉表达，适合迁移到关怀场景。

quote: We can't back away from this, Marty. We've gotta face it head-on. They provoked us. They were throwing foam. Our guys were throwing punches. We're gonna come off the bad guys here. Okay. Okay. I get it. I get it.
chinese: 我们没法从这件事上退缩，马蒂。我们得正面面对。他们挑衅在先，他们扔的是泡沫，而我们的人挥了拳。最后我们会显得像坏人。好，好，我明白了。
reason: 承认事实后提出 face it head-on，形成危机回应。

quote: But I wanna be smart about this. I wanna do something definitive that'll put this to bed and get us back on message. CNN, one on one, you and Underwood. 8:00 tonight.
chinese: 但我想聪明地处理这件事。我想采取决定性措施，让这件事告一段落，并让我们回到原来的议题上。CNN，一对一，你和安德伍德。今晚八点。
reason: put this to bed 与 get back on message 都是可迁移的处理框架。

quote: We wanna create jobs in his district. It's on the Delaware River. I thought we might be able to put a bill together. Something with an economic upside. This has to do with the shipyard closing? We need the shipbuilders' support for his campaign. You think you might be able to draft a bill that he can sponsor?
chinese: 我们想在他的选区创造就业岗位。那里位于特拉华河沿岸。我想我们也许能拟一份法案，带来一些经济收益。这和造船厂关闭有关吗？我们需要造船工人支持他的竞选。你能否起草一份由他提出的法案？
reason: 从目标、法案到支持者，展示项目说明与请求。

quote: You know what? I'm really glad you brought that up, because you know there's absolutely no proof that that incident had anything to do with this strike. And I wanna take the opportunity to say publicly that we categorically condemn any use of violence whatsoever or intimidation.
chinese: 我很高兴你提到了这件事，因为你知道，完全没有证据证明那起事件与这场罢工有关。我想借此机会公开声明，我们绝对谴责任何形式的暴力或恐吓。
reason: 以无证据让步转入公开谴责，适合听辨正式回应。

quote: You can keep trotting out that phrase all you like, but you know what I'd like to do, Frank? I would like to get back to the issue here of educating our children and the fact that congress is not living up to their commitment. Well, you know what I would like?
chinese: 你尽管继续重复那个词，但你知道我想做什么吗，弗兰克？我想回到孩子们的教育问题，以及国会没有履行承诺这一事实上来。你知道我想要什么吗？
reason: 用反驳转回议题，句式长但结构完整。

quote: What? An apology. If not to me, then to my wife. When that brick came through our window, it was terrifying. She's standing right over there. Claire? We need camera two on the wife. Now, why don't you look her in the eye and tell her that your people had nothing to do with that brick?
chinese: 什么？一个道歉。即使不是向我道歉，那就向我妻子道歉。砖头砸进我们家窗户时，太可怕了。她就站在那里。克莱尔？把二号摄像机对准我妻子。现在，你为什么不直视她的眼睛，告诉她你的人和那块砖无关？
reason: 连续完成请求、事实和直接要求，保留为完整现场交换。

quote: Mrs. Underwood, Claire, I am sincerely sorry that you had to go through that ordeal, truly. And it actually sickens me that someone made you feel unsafe in your own home. And I give you my word that to the best of my knowledge, none of our people had anything to do with it.
chinese: 安德伍德太太，克莱尔，我真的非常抱歉你不得不经历那样的磨难。有人让你在自己家里感到不安全，这让我十分痛心。我向你保证，据我所知，我们的人与此事毫无关系。
reason: 正式道歉、同理和有限保证结构完整。

quote: No. You've got this wrong, Marty. There is no "You" and "I" in education. Well, I mean, yes, there are the letters "U" and "I" in the word "Education." But "Education" with a capital E... You know what I'm talking about.
chinese: 不。你搞错了，马蒂。教育里没有“你”和“我”。我的意思是，education 这个词里确实有字母 U 和 I。但首字母大写的“Education”……你懂我的意思。
reason: 完整双关，适合识别角色幽默与字母游戏。

quote: I had no intention of bringing you into this. It wasn't part of a plan. I would've told you if it was. I know. The idea just struck me, and I went with it. I don't mind that you improvised. I just wish you'd done it better.
chinese: 我本来没打算把你牵扯进来。这不在计划之内。如果在计划之内，我会告诉你。我知道。这个想法突然冒出来，我就顺势做了。我不介意你临场发挥，只是希望你能做得更好。
reason: 承认临时决定、解释意图并给出反馈。

quote: I know. It's a mistake. He's young, he's handsome. He's bright. Nobody knows who he is outside of Philadelphia. There's no donor base, no infrastructure. You start me off with funding from the DNC and I'll raise an army around this guy. I will personally oversee his campaign.
chinese: 我知道，这是个错误。他年轻、英俊、聪明。出了费城，没人知道他是谁。没有捐款人基础，也没有竞选组织。你给我民主党全国委员会的启动资金，我就能围绕他组建一支军队。我会亲自监督他的竞选。
reason: 完整说明候选人优势、短板和执行承诺。

quote: It's not easy for me to ask this, but I was wondering if you could put in a good word with my boss. A good word? They're going to discharge me, sir. I messed up. I'm fully aware. But my job, it means everything to me, and I know a good word from you would... Look, I have nothing against you personally, Meechum, but I can't get involved in these sort of affairs.
chinese: 这对我来说很难开口，但我想问您能否替我向上司说几句好话。说好话？他们要解雇我，先生。我搞砸了，我完全清楚。但这份工作对我意义重大，我知道您的一句好话会……听着，就个人而言我不反感你，密查姆，但我不能介入这类事情。
reason: 请求帮助、承认失误和拒绝介入的完整交换。

quote: I love you, Francis. I know. We should say that more often to each other.
chinese: 我爱你，弗兰西斯。我知道。我们应该更经常对彼此说这句话。
reason: 简短的关系确认，完整自然。

quote: So. I've spoken to Patricia Whittaker. She's on board. You'll be getting four million in start-up funding from the DNC. I'll pick the team. You announce in August. But the campaign starts today. Are you ready? I've already put together a platform. It's mostly broad strokes, but we can hone it.
chinese: 我找过帕特里夏·惠特克了。她同意了。民主党全国委员会会给你四百万美元启动资金。我来挑团队。你在八月宣布参选。但竞选今天就开始。你准备好了吗？我已经拟了一份纲领。大体框架都有了，但我们可以继续打磨。
reason: 按资金、团队、日期和纲领顺序启动项目。

quote: Good. The first thing we need to address is your sobriety. Oh, you don't need to worry about that. Have you been going to meetings? You mean AA? Yes. That's not really my thing. If you want my help, then going to meetings is my one requirement. I know I had a problem, Frank. I accept that. And I've taken responsibility for that, but I don't think going to meetings is necessary. You cannot white-knuckle your recovery, Peter. This campaign will be the hardest thing you've ever done in your life.
chinese: 很好。我们首先要解决的是你的戒酒问题。这个不用担心。你参加互诫会了吗？你是说 AA？对。那不太适合我。如果你想要我的帮助，参加互诫会就是我的唯一要求。我知道自己有问题，弗兰克。我承认这一点，也为此负责，但我不认为参加聚会是必要的。彼得，你不能靠意志硬撑着恢复。这次竞选会是你一生中做过的最艰难的事。
reason: 把支持条件、责任和风险直接说清，含 white-knuckle。

quote: You think you are. But we can't take any chances. The party's investing in you. I need to make sure you're investing in yourself.
chinese: 你以为自己准备好了。但我们不能冒任何风险。党内正在投资你。我得确保你也在投资自己。
reason: 把外部投入转成自我投入，短而有力。

quote: The shipyard closing frees up 1,100 acres of federal land. Our goal is to pass a watershed act for the Delaware River. We develop the land in an environmentally-responsible way, creating jobs in the process. How many jobs? Thousands. We're aiming for the $200-million mark. We got a lot of work to do. We do, but you can start with the congressman whose districts fall within the watershed.
chinese: 造船厂关闭后会腾出一千一百英亩联邦土地。我们的目标是通过一项特拉华河流域法案。我们以负责任的环保方式开发土地，同时创造就业岗位。多少岗位？上千个。我们的目标是两亿美元。我们有很多工作要做。确实如此，但你可以从选区位于流域内的议员开始。
reason: 完整的项目说明包含目标、规模、方法和下一步。

quote: Mr. President, we have to end this strike on your terms. Not anyone else's. How? By debating Marty Spinella on CNN? Sir, you have placed your faith in me thus far. I would ask that you continue to do so.
chinese: 总统先生，我们必须按照您的条件结束这场罢工，不能按任何其他人的条件。怎么做？在 CNN 上和马蒂·斯比奈拉辩论？先生，您一直把信任交给我。我请求您继续这样做。
reason: 提出结果、承认质疑并请求继续授权。

quote: Not an easy thing to say no to the most powerful man in the free world. But sometimes the only way to gain your superior's respect is to defy him.
chinese: 对自由世界最有权势的人说不并不容易。但有时，要赢得上司的尊重，唯一的方法就是违抗他。
speaker_scene: Frank; direct address after President meeting
reason: 完整的对照式 Frank aside，给出可迁移的判断。

quote: We might as well do one productive thing while we wait. It requires very little of me and will mean the world to him. It's a very inexpensive investment.
chinese: 反正也是等待，不如做一件有成效的事。这对我来说只是举手之劳，却对他意义重大。这是一笔非常划算的投资。
reason: 用 might as well、requires very little 和 inexpensive investment 组织行动理由。

quote: I want you to listen very closely to what I'm about to say. From this moment on, you are a rock. You absorb nothing, you say nothing, and nothing breaks you. Is that clear? Yes, sir.
chinese: 我要你仔细听我接下来要说的话。从这一刻起，你就是一块石头。你不吸收任何东西，你什么也不说，没有任何事能击垮你。明白了吗？是的，先生。
reason: 连续命令、比喻和确认，适合作为识别型长句。

quote: I remember his exact words. He said, "Claire, if all you want is happiness, Say no. I'm not gonna give you a couple of kids and count the days until retirement. I promise you freedom from that. I promise you'll never be bored."
chinese: 我记得他说的每一个字。他说：“克莱尔，如果你想要的只是幸福，那就拒绝。我不会只给你几个孩子，然后数着日子等退休。我保证让你免受那种生活，也保证你永远不会无聊。”
reason: 婚姻观与承诺的完整叙述，场景依赖较强。

quote: You know, he was the only man-- and there were a lot of others who proposed. But he was the only one who understood me. He didn't put me on some pedestal. He knew that I didn't want to be adored or coddled.
chinese: 他是唯一一个懂我的男人——虽然也有很多其他人向我求过婚。但他是唯一理解我的人。他没有把我捧上神坛。他知道我不想被崇拜或娇宠。
reason: 通过对比说明理解、尊重与关系边界。

quote: He's a man who knows how to take what he wants.
chinese: 他是个知道如何得到自己想要之物的人。
reason: 短句总结人物行动逻辑，作为 Archive。

quote: Hey, it's Peter. I don't expect you to call me back, but I wanted to let you know I stopped drinking last night, and I went to my first AA meeting this morning. Um, I'm supposed to reach out and make amends to those I've hurt. But I guess the real reason I called you is just to say I love you and I miss you. I hope you're well.
chinese: 嗨，是彼得。我不指望你回电话，但我想告诉你，我昨晚停止喝酒了，今天早上第一次参加了 AA 聚会。我应该联系那些被我伤害过的人并作出弥补。但我想，我打电话的真正原因只是想说我爱你、想你。希望你一切都好。
reason: 完整留言从交代变化到表达歉意、爱与想念。

quote: How many characters in a tweet? 140. Type this, let me know where you land. "Eight-year-old Washington DC boy killed by a stray bullet in gangland shoot-out." 61 characters left. "Should have been in school"? 30 left. "Spinella to blame?" 128. Press "Send."
chinese: 一条推特能写几个字？140。按我说的写，告诉我还剩多少字。“八岁华盛顿男孩被黑帮枪战中的流弹击中身亡。”还剩 61 个字。“本该在学校里”？还剩 30 个字。“斯比奈拉难辞其咎”？128。按“发送”。
reason: 从字数约束到删改短句，展示编辑与发布流程。

quote: If Tyler's school had been in session, this senseless killing would have never taken place. We need to end this strike now and get all our children back in school where they belong before we risk another death like this. So, Mr. Spinella, I am headed to the capitol right now, and I will remain there until you are ready to meet and talk so that we can end this pointless strike.
chinese: 如果泰勒的学校当时开课，这场毫无意义的杀戮就不会发生。我们现在必须结束罢工，让所有孩子回到他们应该在的学校，以免再有类似的死亡。所以，斯比奈拉先生，我现在就前往国会大厦，并会一直待在那里，直到你愿意会面交谈，以便我们结束这场毫无意义的罢工。
speaker_scene: Frank; press statement outside victim home
